source_name: Veřejný rejstřík — Justice open data (dataor.justice.cz, full + actual XML/CSV)
license: Open data (CKAN; license field empty per package — confirm exact terms)
data_freshness: monthly full + frequent incremental; packages per legal-form/court/year
record_shape: xml_subjekt_with_typed_udaj_items (each <Subjekt> has nazev/ico/zapisDatum + <udaje><Udaj> keyed by udajTyp/kod)

fields.meaning: IČO of the entity; join key. May be stored without zero-padding.
fields.limitations: Unpadded (3431509 = 03431509) — normalize to 8 digits to join with ARES.
Also repeated as Udaj/NAZEV with zapisDatum.

fields.meaning: Date the entity was entered into the public register (incorporation).
Legal form with code, full name and abbreviation (e.g. Akciová společnost / as).
fields.analysis_notes: company_type. Note: package name also encodes form (sro/as/…).

fields.meaning: Registered office, structured: obec, castObce, ulice, cisloPo/cisloOr, psc, okres.
fields.limitations: No RUIAN codes here (unlike ARES) — text components only.

fields.meaning: Registered/share capital: vklad (typ=KORUNY + textValue) and splaceni (% paid).
fields.limitations: Currency CZK. A register value, not an annual statement.
fields.analysis_notes: share_capital_czk. The only structured 'financial' field in this dump.

fields.meaning: Scope of business / objects of business as free text (one entry per activity).
example_values: Výroba, obchod a služby neuvedené v přílohách 1 až 3 živnostenského zákona
Pronájem nemovitostí, bytů a prostor sloužících k podnikání.
fields.limitations: Free text, NOT a NACE code — use ARES czNace2008 for codes.
fields.analysis_notes: activity (textual). PREDMET_CINNOSTI is the analogous non-business activity.

fields.meaning: Member of the statutory body (board): osoba (jmeno, prijmeni, narozDatum=DOB), funkce, clenstviOd/funkceOd.
fields.limitations: PERSONAL DATA incl. DATE OF BIRTH (narozDatum). GDPR.
fields.analysis_notes: officers[]. Apply a GDPR lawful basis + retention; no direct marketing. Example values kept generic (no real person).

fields.meaning: Member of the supervisory board (a.s.); same osoba shape incl. DOB.
fields.limitations: PERSONAL DATA incl. DOB. GDPR. No real values copied.
fields.analysis_notes: officers[] (supervisory). Distinguish role from statutory board.

fields.meaning: Shareholder of an akciová společnost (a.s.) where recorded in the register.
fields.limitations: Present for a.s. (sole/major shareholders); not all shareholders are registered. PERSONAL DATA where a natural person. GDPR.
fields.analysis_notes: owners[]. For s.r.o. the analogous concept is SPOLECNIK (members), in the sro packages.

fields.meaning: Court file mark: soud (court kod/nazev), oddil, vlozka (e.g. B 20032 / Městský soud v Praze).
fields.analysis_notes: court_file_mark; also the subjektId link to Sbírka listin.

fields.meaning: Percentage of the share capital paid up.
Insolvency records/notes attached to the entity (INSOLVENCNI_ZAPIS, INSOLVENCNI_SPRAVCE).
fields.analysis_notes: Feeds status (e.g. in insolvency). Cross-reference ISIR for detail.

fields.meaning: Liquidator appointed when the company is in liquidation.
fields.limitations: Presence implies liquidation; PERSONAL DATA. GDPR.
